Legal Standards.legal_standard: Endangered Species Act (ESA) / California Endangered Species Act (CESA)
Legal Standards.caption: State and federal legislation providing primary legal protection for salmon and other listed species. ESA implementation requires Biological Opinions (BiOps), which carry the force of federal law and govern operations affecting endangered species.
Legal Standards.info: State and federal legislation providing primary legal protection for salmon and other listed species. ESA implementation requires Biological Opinions (BiOps), which carry the force of federal law and govern operations affecting endangered species.

vocabulary.definition: Biological Opinions (BiOps); scope: Operational requirements for activities affecting listed species such as salmon; legal weight: Federal law

Legal Standards.caption: Provides federal legal authority and oversight for the development, approval, and implementation of state and local water quality standards.
Legal Standards.info: Provides federal legal authority and oversight for the development, approval, and implementation of state and local water quality standards.

Legal Standards.caption: Statutory framework encompassing regulatory authorities that protect salmon populations indirectly through water management and more directly through protection of commercial and recreational fishing.
Legal Standards.info: Statutory framework encompassing regulatory authorities that protect salmon populations indirectly through water management and more directly through protection of commercial and recreational fishing.

Legal Standards.legal_standard: Federal Clean Water Act (CWA) / Porter-Cologne Water Quality Control Act
Legal Standards.caption: Establish the authority and scope of water quality regulation, including determination of covered waters. Temperature is explicitly addressed as a water quality parameter under this regulatory umbrella.
Legal Standards.info: Establish the authority and scope of water quality regulation, including determination of covered waters. Temperature is explicitly addressed as a water quality parameter under this regulatory umbrella.

vocabulary.definition: Water temperature; regulatory context: Water quality objective

Legal Standards.legal_standard: Central Valley Project Improvement Act (CVPIA) / Anadromous Fish Restoration Program (AFRP)
Legal Standards.caption: Requires population doubling of anadromous fish in Central Valley streams and mitigation of adverse impacts from CVP operations. Multiple environmental factors are implicated.
Legal Standards.info: Requires population doubling of anadromous fish in Central Valley streams and mitigation of adverse impacts from CVP operations. Multiple environmental factors are implicated.

vocabulary.definition: Doubling of anadromous fish populations; implicated factors: Flows, Temperature, Water quality, Riparian habitat

Legal Standards.legal_standard: SWRCB Order 90-5 and USBR Temperature Management Plan
Legal Standards.caption: Regulates USBR water releases to protect salmon, native fish, and habitat in the Sacramento and Trinity River Basins, with a primary focus on temperature control through reservoir operations.
Legal Standards.info: Regulates USBR water releases to protect salmon, native fish, and habitat in the Sacramento and Trinity River Basins, with a primary focus on temperature control through reservoir operations.

vocabulary.definition: Daily average water temperature of 56°F; location: Sacramento River at Red Bluff; mechanism: Reservoir release management (e.g., Shasta Dam)
Keswick Dam, Spring Creek Power Plant, Trinity River Division (Upper Sacramento River)

Legal Standards.caption: Science-based salinity metrics developed under EPA authority to support water quality protection objectives.
Legal Standards.info: Science-based salinity metrics developed under EPA authority to support water quality protection objectives.

Tier 1.threshold: >=80% chance (>800/1000 runs) population grows 8x starting size (rolling 10-year average).

policies.policy_name: Reservoir releases & diversion management (%UIF, X2, temperature, salinity)
policies.note: Managed largely through reservoir releases or changes in diversions; affects salmon and water availability, implicating curtailments in drier years. Water comes from aggregate storage, not individual rights holders.

policies.policy_name: USFWS ESA BiOps for federal projects
policies.note: Biological Opinions produced for projects potentially affecting listed species or critical habitat. Includes incidental take and mitigation measures; part of normal non-emergency water management.
Normal fishing season continues under Tier 1 conditions.

Tier 2.threshold: >=80% chance (>800/1000 runs) population grows 2-8x starting size (rolling 10-year average).

policies.policy_name: Reservoir releases & diversion management (%UIF, X2, temperature, salinity)
policies.note: Flow, salinity/X2, and temperature management continues as in Tier 1.
Fishing season likely reduced under Tier 2 conditions.

Tier 3.threshold: >=80% chance (>800/1000 runs) population exceeds starting size (rolling 10-year average).

policies.note: Doubled impacts on already diminished populations, addressed mainly through litigation and injunctive relief; includes flows, environmental review, CVP operations, and salmon habitat management.
Fishing season much reduced or eliminated under Tier 3 conditions.
Population collapse occurs; harm addressed through litigation as in Tier 3 but at a full emergency level.
